skill.name: Global Tech Stack
skill.description: Understand and apply the n8n community node tech stack including TypeScript strict mode, Node.js v22+, n8n-workflow package, and build tools. Use this skill when setting up new n8n node projects, configuring package.json, writing TypeScript with strict mode, running build or dev scripts, configuring ESLint with n8n rules, setting up Jest tests, or preparing packages for npm publishing. Apply when making decisions about runtime, dependencies, or tooling in n8n node development.
skill.body:
## When to use this skill:

- When creating a new n8n community node package
- When configuring package.json for n8n nodes
- When writing TypeScript in strict mode
- When using n8n-workflow types and interfaces
- When running npm build, dev, lint, or lintfix scripts
- When configuring ESLint with eslint-plugin-n8n-nodes-base
- When setting up Prettier for code formatting
- When configuring Jest for testing n8n nodes
- When using nock for HTTP mocking in tests
- When linking nodes locally for testing (~/.n8n/custom)
- When preparing a package for npm publishing
- When choosing between declarative and programmatic build styles

generated_query: I'm building an n8n community node for the Todoist REST API. The node should allow users to create tasks with a title, due date, and priority, using OAuth2 credentials. I need help setting up the entire project from scratch: scaffolding the directory, writing a proper package.json with `n8n-workflow` and `@types/node` dependencies, enabling TypeScript strict mode, configuring ESLint with the `eslint-plugin-n8n-nodes-base` rules, setting up Prettier, and creating Jest tests with nock for mocking HTTP calls to the Todoist API. Also, I'll need build and dev scripts, and guidance on how to link the node locally (`~/.n8n/custom`) for testing. Please generate the full file structure, credential class, node class in declarative style, and a sample test file for the node's execute method.

edit_instructions.target_text: - When using nock for HTTP mocking in tests
edit_instructions.rationale: Without nock for mocking HTTP calls, the skill fails to support the user's required test setup for the Todoist API.
